    def run(self, tables):
        connection = _sql_connection()
        for name, rows in tables.items():

        stages = [['s', "WITH
    s AS (
        SELECT
            employee_id,
            SUM(salary) OVER (ORDER BY salary) AS cur
        FROM Candidates
        WHERE experience = 'Senior'

        SELECT

        FROM Candidates
        WHERE experience = 'Senior'

        SELECT

                FROM s
                WHERE cur <= 70000,

            ) + SUM(salary) OVER (ORDER BY salary) AS cur
        FROM Candidates
        WHERE experience = 'Junior'

        intermediate = []

SELECT

    COUNT(employee_id) AS accepted_candidates
FROM s
WHERE cur <= 70000
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'Junior' AS experience,
    COUNT(employee_id) AS accepted_candidates
FROM j
WHERE cur <= 70000;"
        result = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(query)]

import sqlite3,datetime,calendar
def _sql_connection():
    connection=sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
    connection.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    def parsed(value):
        return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(str(value))
    functions={
        'CONCAT':(-1,lambda *values: ''.join(str(v) for v in values)),
        'CONCAT_WS':(-1,lambda separator,*values: separator.join(str(v) for v in values if v is not None)),
        'IF':(3,lambda c,a,b:a if c else b),
        'YEAR':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).year), 'MONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).month),
        'DAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day), 'DAYOFMONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day),
        'WEEKDAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).weekday()), 'DAYOFWEEK':(1,lambda d:(parsed(d).weekday()+1)%7+1),
        'DATEDIFF':(2,lambda a,b:(parsed(a)-parsed(b)).days),
        'TIMESTAMPDIFF':(3,lambda unit,a,b:int((parsed(b)-parsed(a)).total_seconds()/{'SECOND':1,'MINUTE':60,'HOUR':3600,'DAY':86400}[unit])),
        'DATE_FORMAT':(2,lambda d,f:parsed(d).strftime(f.replace('%i','%M'))),
        'DATE_ADD':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)+datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'DATE_SUB':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)-datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'GREATEST':(-1,lambda *a:max(a)), 'LEAST':(-1,lambda *a:min(a)),
        'FLOOR':(1,math.floor),'CEIL':(1,math.ceil),'CEILING':(1,math.ceil),
        'LEFT':(2,lambda s,n:s[:n]),'RIGHT':(2,lambda s,n:s[-n:]),
        'REGEXP':(2,lambda pattern,value:bool(re.search(pattern,str(value))))
    }
    for name,(arity,function) in functions.items():
        connection.create_function(name,arity,function)
    return connection

title: Minimum Number of Operations to Make Array Continuous
code:
class Solution:

    def minOperations(self, nums):
        n = len(nums)
        ans = n
        nums = sorted(set(nums))
        for i, start in enumerate(nums):
            end = start + n - 1
            index = bisect_right(nums, end)
            uniqueLength = index - i
            ans = min(ans, n - uniqueLength)
        return ans

title: Grid Game
code:
class Solution:

    def gridGame(self, grid):
        n = len(grid[0])
        ans = math.inf
        sumRow0 = sum(grid[0])
        sumRow1 = 0
        for i in range(n):
            sumRow0 -= grid[0][i]
            ans = min(ans, max(sumRow0, sumRow1))
            sumRow1 += grid[1][i]
        return ans

title: Maximum Number of Ways to Partition an Array
code:
class Solution:

    def waysToPartition(self, nums, k):
        n = len(nums)
        summ = sum(nums)
        prefix = 0
        l = collections.Counter()
        r = collections.Counter()
        for pivot in range(1, n):
            prefix += nums[pivot - 1]
            suffix = summ - prefix
            r[prefix - suffix] += 1
        ans = r[0]
        prefix = 0
        for num in nums:
            ans = max(ans, l[k - num] + r[num - k])
            prefix += num
            suffix = summ - prefix
            diff = prefix - suffix
            r[diff] -= 1
            l[diff] += 1
        return ans

code:
class Solution:
    def run(self, tables):
        connection = _sql_connection()
        for name, rows in tables.items():
            if not rows:
                continue
            columns = list(rows[0])
            definitions = []
            for column in columns:
                values = [row[column] for row in rows if row[column] is not None]
                kind = "NUMERIC" if values and all(isinstance(value,(int,float)) for value in values) else "TEXT"
                definitions.append(chr(34)+column+chr(34)+" "+kind)
            connection.execute("CREATE TABLE "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" ("+",".join(definitions)+")")
            placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in columns)
            connection.executemany("INSERT INTO "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" VALUES ("+placeholders+")",[[row[c] for c in columns] for row in rows])
        stages = []
        intermediate = []
        for stage, statement in stages:
            rows = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(statement)]
            intermediate.append({"stage":stage,"rows":rows})
        query = 'SELECT problem_id\nFROM Problems\nWHERE likes / (likes + dislikes) < 0.6\nORDER BY problem_id;'
        result = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(query)]
        connection.close()
        return result

title: Count Nodes With the Highest Score
code:
class Solution:

    def countHighestScoreNodes(self, parents):
        tree = [[] for _ in range(len(parents))]
        for i, parent in enumerate(parents):
            if parent == -1:
                continue
            tree[parent].append(i)
        ans = 0
        maxScore = 0

        def dfs(u):
            nonlocal ans
            nonlocal maxScore
            count = 1
            score = 1
            for v in tree[u]:
                childCount = dfs(v)
                count += childCount
                score *= childCount
            score *= len(parents) - count or 1
            if score > maxScore:
                maxScore = score
                ans = 1
            elif score == maxScore:
                ans += 1
            return count
        dfs(0)
        return ans
guideVi: Theo dõi node hiện tại, các cạnh và ngăn xếp gọi hàm. Khi quay về từ cây con, giá trị trả về được dùng để cập nhật node cha.

title: Reverse Nodes in Even Length Groups
code:
class Solution:

    def reverseEvenLengthGroups(self, head):
        dummy = ListNode(0, head)
        prev = dummy
        tail = head
        next = head.next
        groupLength = 1

        def getTailAndLength(head, groupLength):
            length = 1
            tail = head
            while length < groupLength and tail.next:
                tail = tail.next
                length += 1
            return (tail, length)

        def reverse(head):
            prev = None
            while head:
                next = head.next
                head.next = prev
                prev = head
                head = next
            return prev
        while True:
            if groupLength % 2 == 1:
                prev.next = head
                prev = tail
            else:
                tail.next = None
                prev.next = reverse(head)
                head.next = next
                prev = head
            if not next:
                break
            head = next
            tail, length = getTailAndLength(head, groupLength + 1)
            next = tail.next
            groupLength = length
        return dummy.next

class Solution:
    def run(self, tables):
        connection = _sql_connection()
        for name, rows in tables.items():
            if not rows:
                continue
            columns = list(rows[0])
            definitions = []
            for column in columns:
                values = [row[column] for row in rows if row[column] is not None]
                kind = "NUMERIC" if values and all(isinstance(value,(int,float)) for value in values) else "TEXT"
                definitions.append(chr(34)+column+chr(34)+" "+kind)
            connection.execute("CREATE TABLE "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" ("+",".join(definitions)+")")
            placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in columns)
            connection.executemany("INSERT INTO "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" VALUES ("+placeholders+")",[[row[c] for c in columns] for row in rows])
        stages = []
        intermediate = []
        for stage, statement in stages:
            rows = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(statement)]
            intermediate.append({"stage":stage,"rows":rows})
        query = 'SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS rich_count\nFROM Store\nWHERE amount > 500;'
        result = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(query)]
        connection.close()
        return result

import sqlite3,datetime,calendar
def _sql_connection():
    connection=sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
    connection.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    def parsed(value):
        return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(str(value))
    functions={
        'CONCAT':(-1,lambda *values: ''.join(str(v) for v in values)),
        'CONCAT_WS':(-1,lambda separator,*values: separator.join(str(v) for v in values if v is not None)),
        'IF':(3,lambda c,a,b:a if c else b),
        'YEAR':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).year), 'MONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).month),
        'DAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day), 'DAYOFMONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day),
        'WEEKDAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).weekday()), 'DAYOFWEEK':(1,lambda d:(parsed(d).weekday()+1)%7+1),
        'DATEDIFF':(2,lambda a,b:(parsed(a)-parsed(b)).days),
        'TIMESTAMPDIFF':(3,lambda unit,a,b:int((parsed(b)-parsed(a)).total_seconds()/{'SECOND':1,'MINUTE':60,'HOUR':3600,'DAY':86400}[unit])),
        'DATE_FORMAT':(2,lambda d,f:parsed(d).strftime(f.replace('%i','%M'))),
        'DATE_ADD':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)+datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'DATE_SUB':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)-datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'GREATEST':(-1,lambda *a:max(a)), 'LEAST':(-1,lambda *a:min(a)),
        'FLOOR':(1,math.floor),'CEIL':(1,math.ceil),'CEILING':(1,math.ceil),
        'LEFT':(2,lambda s,n:s[:n]),'RIGHT':(2,lambda s,n:s[-n:]),
        'REGEXP':(2,lambda pattern,value:bool(re.search(pattern,str(value))))
    }
    for name,(arity,function) in functions.items():
        connection.create_function(name,arity,function)
    return connection

def _sql_connection():
    connection=sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
    connection.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    def parsed(value):
        return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(str(value))
    functions={
        'CONCAT':(-1,lambda *values: ''.join(str(v) for v in values)),
        'CONCAT_WS':(-1,lambda separator,*values: separator.join(str(v) for v in values if v is not None)),
        'IF':(3,lambda c,a,b:a if c else b),
        'YEAR':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).year), 'MONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).month),
        'DAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day), 'DAYOFMONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day),
        'WEEKDAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).weekday()), 'DAYOFWEEK':(1,lambda d:(parsed(d).weekday()+1)%7+1),
        'DATEDIFF':(2,lambda a,b:(parsed(a)-parsed(b)).days),
        'TIMESTAMPDIFF':(3,lambda unit,a,b:int((parsed(b)-parsed(a)).total_seconds()/{'SECOND':1,'MINUTE':60,'HOUR':3600,'DAY':86400}[unit])),
        'DATE_FORMAT':(2,lambda d,f:parsed(d).strftime(f.replace('%i','%M'))),
        'DATE_ADD':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)+datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'DATE_SUB':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)-datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'GREATEST':(-1,lambda *a:max(a)), 'LEAST':(-1,lambda *a:min(a)),
        'FLOOR':(1,math.floor),'CEIL':(1,math.ceil),'CEILING':(1,math.ceil),
        'LEFT':(2,lambda s,n:s[:n]),'RIGHT':(2,lambda s,n:s[-n:]),
        'REGEXP':(2,lambda pattern,value:bool(re.search(pattern,str(value))))
    }
    for name,(arity,function) in functions.items():
        connection.create_function(name,arity,function)
    return connection

title: Execution of All Suffix Instructions Staying in a Grid
code:
class Solution:

    def executeInstructions(self, n, startPos, s):
        moves = {'L': (0, -1), 'R': (0, 1), 'U': (-1, 0), 'D': (1, 0)}
        m = len(s)
        uMost = startPos[0] + 1
        dMost = n - startPos[0]
        lMost = startPos[1] + 1
        rMost = n - startPos[1]
        ans = [0] * m
        reach = {(0, None): m, (None, 0): m}
        x = 0
        y = 0
        for i in reversed(range(m)):
            dx, dy = moves[s[i]]
            x -= dx
            y -= dy
            reach[x, None] = i
            reach[None, y] = i
            out = min(reach.get((x - uMost, None), math.inf), reach.get((x + dMost, None), math.inf), reach.get((None, y - lMost), math.inf), reach.get((None, y + rMost), math.inf))
            ans[i] = m - i if out == math.inf else out - i - 1
        return ans

title: Maximum Twin Sum of a Linked List
code:
class Solution:

    def pairSum(self, head):

        def reverseList(head):
            prev = None
            while head:
                next = head.next
                head.next = prev
                prev = head
                head = next
            return prev
        ans = 0
        slow = head
        fast = head
        while fast and fast.next:
            slow = slow.next
            fast = fast.next.next
        tail = reverseList(slow)
        while tail:
            ans = max(ans, head.val + tail.val)
            head = head.next
            tail = tail.next
        return ans

title: The Number of Passengers in Each Bus I
code:
class Solution:
    def run(self, tables):
        connection = _sql_connection()
        for name, rows in tables.items():
            if not rows:
                continue
            columns = list(rows[0])
            definitions = []
            for column in columns:
                values = [row[column] for row in rows if row[column] is not None]
                kind = "NUMERIC" if values and all(isinstance(value,(int,float)) for value in values) else "TEXT"
                definitions.append(chr(34)+column+chr(34)+" "+kind)
            connection.execute("CREATE TABLE "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" ("+",".join(definitions)+")")
            placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in columns)
            connection.executemany("INSERT INTO "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" VALUES ("+placeholders+")",[[row[c] for c in columns] for row in rows])
        stages = []
        intermediate = []
        for stage, statement in stages:
            rows = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(statement)]
            intermediate.append({"stage":stage,"rows":rows})
        query = 'SELECT\n    bus_id,\n    COUNT(passenger_id) - LAG(COUNT(passenger_id), 1, 0) OVER (\n        ORDER BY b.arrival_time\n    ) AS passengers_cnt\nFROM Buses AS b\nLEFT JOIN Passengers AS p ON p.arrival_time <= b.arrival_time\nGROUP BY 1\nORDER BY 1;'
        result = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(query)]
        connection.close()
        return result

import sqlite3,datetime,calendar
def _sql_connection():
    connection=sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
    connection.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    def parsed(value):
        return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(str(value))
    functions={
        'CONCAT':(-1,lambda *values: ''.join(str(v) for v in values)),
        'CONCAT_WS':(-1,lambda separator,*values: separator.join(str(v) for v in values if v is not None)),
        'IF':(3,lambda c,a,b:a if c else b),
        'YEAR':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).year), 'MONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).month),
        'DAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day), 'DAYOFMONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day),
        'WEEKDAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).weekday()), 'DAYOFWEEK':(1,lambda d:(parsed(d).weekday()+1)%7+1),
        'DATEDIFF':(2,lambda a,b:(parsed(a)-parsed(b)).days),
        'TIMESTAMPDIFF':(3,lambda unit,a,b:int((parsed(b)-parsed(a)).total_seconds()/{'SECOND':1,'MINUTE':60,'HOUR':3600,'DAY':86400}[unit])),
        'DATE_FORMAT':(2,lambda d,f:parsed(d).strftime(f.replace('%i','%M'))),
        'DATE_ADD':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)+datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'DATE_SUB':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)-datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'GREATEST':(-1,lambda *a:max(a)), 'LEAST':(-1,lambda *a:min(a)),
        'FLOOR':(1,math.floor),'CEIL':(1,math.ceil),'CEILING':(1,math.ceil),
        'LEFT':(2,lambda s,n:s[:n]),'RIGHT':(2,lambda s,n:s[-n:]),
        'REGEXP':(2,lambda pattern,value:bool(re.search(pattern,str(value))))
    }
    for name,(arity,function) in functions.items():
        connection.create_function(name,arity,function)
    return connection

title: Choose Numbers From Two Arrays in Range
code:
class Solution:

    def countSubranges(self, nums1, nums2):
        MOD = 1000000007
        ans = 0
        dp = collections.Counter()
        for a, b in zip(nums1, nums2):
            newDp = collections.Counter()
            newDp[a] += 1
            newDp[-b] += 1
            for prevSum, count in dp.items():
                newDp[prevSum + a] += count
                newDp[prevSum + a] %= MOD
                newDp[prevSum - b] += count
                newDp[prevSum - b] %= MOD
            dp = newDp
            ans += dp[0]
            ans %= MOD
        return ans

class Solution:

    def maxScoreIndices(self, nums):
        zeros = nums.count(0)
        ones = len(nums) - zeros
        ans = [0]
        leftZeros = 0
        leftOnes = 0
        maxScore = ones
        for i, num in enumerate(nums):
            leftZeros += num == 0
            leftOnes += num == 1
            rightOnes = ones - leftOnes
            score = leftZeros + rightOnes
            if maxScore == score:
                ans.append(i + 1)
            elif maxScore < score:
                maxScore = score
                ans = [i + 1]
        return ans

class Solution:
    def run(self, tables):
        connection = _sql_connection()
        for name, rows in tables.items():
            if not rows:
                continue
            columns = list(rows[0])
            definitions = []
            for column in columns:
                values = [row[column] for row in rows if row[column] is not None]
                kind = "NUMERIC" if values and all(isinstance(value,(int,float)) for value in values) else "TEXT"
                definitions.append(chr(34)+column+chr(34)+" "+kind)
            connection.execute("CREATE TABLE "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" ("+",".join(definitions)+")")
            placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in columns)
            connection.executemany("INSERT INTO "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" VALUES ("+placeholders+")",[[row[c] for c in columns] for row in rows])
        stages = [['P', 'WITH\n    P AS (\n        SELECT team_id, SUM(points_change) AS delta\n        FROM PointsChange\n        GROUP BY team_id\n    ) SELECT * FROM P']]
        intermediate = []
        for stage, statement in stages:
            rows = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(statement)]
            intermediate.append({"stage":stage,"rows":rows})
        query = "WITH\n    P AS (\n        SELECT team_id, SUM(points_change) AS delta\n        FROM PointsChange\n        GROUP BY team_id\n    )\nSELECT\n    team_id,\n    name,\n    CAST(RANK() OVER (ORDER BY points DESC, name) AS SIGNED) - CAST(\n        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (points + delta) DESC, name) AS SIGNED\n    ) AS 'rank_diff'\nFROM TeamPoints\nJOIN P USING (team_id);"
        result = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(query)]
        result.sort(key=lambda row: json.dumps(row,sort_keys=True))
        connection.close()
        return result

import sqlite3,datetime,calendar
def _sql_connection():
    connection=sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
    connection.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    def parsed(value):
        return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(str(value))
    functions={
        'CONCAT':(-1,lambda *values: ''.join(str(v) for v in values)),
        'CONCAT_WS':(-1,lambda separator,*values: separator.join(str(v) for v in values if v is not None)),
        'IF':(3,lambda c,a,b:a if c else b),
        'YEAR':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).year), 'MONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).month),
        'DAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day), 'DAYOFMONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day),
        'WEEKDAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).weekday()), 'DAYOFWEEK':(1,lambda d:(parsed(d).weekday()+1)%7+1),
        'DATEDIFF':(2,lambda a,b:(parsed(a)-parsed(b)).days),
        'TIMESTAMPDIFF':(3,lambda unit,a,b:int((parsed(b)-parsed(a)).total_seconds()/{'SECOND':1,'MINUTE':60,'HOUR':3600,'DAY':86400}[unit])),
        'DATE_FORMAT':(2,lambda d,f:parsed(d).strftime(f.replace('%i','%M'))),
        'DATE_ADD':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)+datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'DATE_SUB':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)-datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'GREATEST':(-1,lambda *a:max(a)), 'LEAST':(-1,lambda *a:min(a)),
        'FLOOR':(1,math.floor),'CEIL':(1,math.ceil),'CEILING':(1,math.ceil),
        'LEFT':(2,lambda s,n:s[:n]),'RIGHT':(2,lambda s,n:s[-n:]),
        'REGEXP':(2,lambda pattern,value:bool(re.search(pattern,str(value))))
    }
    for name,(arity,function) in functions.items():
        connection.create_function(name,arity,function)
    return connection

title: Minimum Operations to Halve Array Sum
code:
class Solution:

    def halveArray(self, nums):
        halfSum = sum(nums) / 2
        ans = 0
        runningSum = 0.0
        maxHeap = [-num for num in nums]
        heapq.heapify(maxHeap)
        while runningSum < halfSum:
            maxValue = -heapq.heappop(maxHeap) / 2
            runningSum += maxValue
            heapq.heappush(maxHeap, -maxValue)
            ans += 1
        return ans

code:
class Solution:

    def maxTrailingZeros(self, grid):
        m = len(grid)
        n = len(grid[0])
        leftPrefix2 = [[0] * n for _ in range(m)]
        leftPrefix5 = [[0] * n for _ in range(m)]
        topPrefix2 = [[0] * n for _ in range(m)]
        topPrefix5 = [[0] * n for _ in range(m)]

        def getCount(num, factor):
            count = 0
            while num % factor == 0:
                num //= factor
                count += 1
            return count
        for i in range(m):
            for j in range(n):
                leftPrefix2[i][j] = getCount(grid[i][j], 2)
                leftPrefix5[i][j] = getCount(grid[i][j], 5)
                if j:
                    leftPrefix2[i][j] += leftPrefix2[i][j - 1]
                    leftPrefix5[i][j] += leftPrefix5[i][j - 1]
        for j in range(n):
            for i in range(m):
                topPrefix2[i][j] = getCount(grid[i][j], 2)
                topPrefix5[i][j] = getCount(grid[i][j], 5)
                if i:
                    topPrefix2[i][j] += topPrefix2[i - 1][j]
                    topPrefix5[i][j] += topPrefix5[i - 1][j]
        ans = 0
        for i in range(m):
            for j in range(n):
                curr2 = getCount(grid[i][j], 2)
                curr5 = getCount(grid[i][j], 5)
                l2 = leftPrefix2[i][j]
                l5 = leftPrefix5[i][j]
                r2 = leftPrefix2[i][n - 1] - (0 if j == 0 else leftPrefix2[i][j - 1])
                r5 = leftPrefix5[i][n - 1] - (0 if j == 0 else leftPrefix5[i][j - 1])
                t2 = topPrefix2[i][j]
                t5 = topPrefix5[i][j]
                d2 = topPrefix2[m - 1][j] - (0 if i == 0 else topPrefix2[i - 1][j])
                d5 = topPrefix5[m - 1][j] - (0 if i == 0 else topPrefix5[i - 1][j])
                ans = max(ans, min(l2 + t2 - curr2, l5 + t5 - curr5), min(r2 + t2 - curr2, r5 + t5 - curr5), min(l2 + d2 - curr2, l5 + d5 - curr5), min(r2 + d2 - curr2, r5 + d5 - curr5))
        return ans

title: Dynamic Unpivoting of a Table

class Solution:
    def run(self, tables):
        connection = _sql_connection()
        for name, rows in tables.items():
            if not rows:
                continue
            columns = list(rows[0])
            definitions = []
            for column in columns:
                values = [row[column] for row in rows if row[column] is not None]
                kind = "NUMERIC" if values and all(isinstance(value,(int,float)) for value in values) else "TEXT"
                definitions.append(chr(34)+column+chr(34)+" "+kind)
            connection.execute("CREATE TABLE "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" ("+",".join(definitions)+")")
            placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in columns)
            connection.executemany("INSERT INTO "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" VALUES ("+placeholders+")",[[row[c] for c in columns] for row in rows])
        stages = []
        intermediate = []
        for stage, statement in stages:
            rows = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(statement)]
            intermediate.append({"stage":stage,"rows":rows})
        query = "CREATE PROCEDURE UnpivotProducts()
BEGIN

    SET group_concat_max_len = 5000;
    WITH
        t AS (
            SELECT column_name
            FROM information_schema.columns
            WHERE
                table_schema = DATABASE()
                AND table_name = 'Products'
                AND column_name != 'product_id'
        )
    SELECT
        GROUP_CONCAT(
            'SELECT product_id, \'',
            column_name,
            '\' store, ',
            column_name,
            ' price FROM Products WHERE ',
            column_name,
            ' IS NOT NULL' SEPARATOR ' UNION '
        ) INTO @sql from t;
    PREPARE stmt FROM @sql;
    EXECUTE stmt;
    DEALLOCATE PREPARE stmt;
END;"
        result = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(query)]

title: Minimum Average Difference
code:
class Solution:

    def minimumAverageDifference(self, nums):
        n = len(nums)
        ans = 0
        minDiff = inf
        prefix = 0
        suffix = sum(nums)
        for i, num in enumerate(nums):
            prefix += num
            suffix -= num
            prefixAvg = prefix // (i + 1)
            suffixAvg = 0 if i == n - 1 else suffix // (n - 1 - i)
            diff = abs(prefixAvg - suffixAvg)
            if diff < minDiff:
                ans = i
                minDiff = diff
        return ans

class Solution:
    def run(self, tables):
        connection = _sql_connection()
        for name, rows in tables.items():
            if not rows:
                continue
            columns = list(rows[0])
            definitions = []
            for column in columns:
                values = [row[column] for row in rows if row[column] is not None]
                kind = "NUMERIC" if values and all(isinstance(value,(int,float)) for value in values) else "TEXT"
                definitions.append(chr(34)+column+chr(34)+" "+kind)
            connection.execute("CREATE TABLE "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" ("+",".join(definitions)+")")
            placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in columns)
            connection.executemany("INSERT INTO "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" VALUES ("+placeholders+")",[[row[c] for c in columns] for row in rows])
        stages = [['P', 'WITH\n    P AS (\n        SELECT product_id, YEAR(purchase_date) AS y, COUNT(1) >= 3 AS mark\n        FROM Orders\n        GROUP BY 1, 2\n    ) SELECT * FROM P']]
        intermediate = []
        for stage, statement in stages:
            rows = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(statement)]
            intermediate.append({"stage":stage,"rows":rows})
        query = 'WITH\n    P AS (\n        SELECT product_id, YEAR(purchase_date) AS y, COUNT(1) >= 3 AS mark\n        FROM Orders\n        GROUP BY 1, 2\n    )\nSELECT DISTINCT p1.product_id\nFROM P AS p1\nJOIN P AS p2 ON p1.y = p2.y - 1 AND p1.product_id = p2.product_id\nWHERE p1.mark AND p2.mark;'
        result = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(query)]
        result.sort(key=lambda row: json.dumps(row,sort_keys=True))
        connection.close()
        return result

import sqlite3,datetime,calendar
def _sql_connection():
    connection=sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
    connection.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    def parsed(value):
        return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(str(value))
    functions={
        'CONCAT':(-1,lambda *values: ''.join(str(v) for v in values)),
        'CONCAT_WS':(-1,lambda separator,*values: separator.join(str(v) for v in values if v is not None)),
        'IF':(3,lambda c,a,b:a if c else b),
        'YEAR':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).year), 'MONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).month),
        'DAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day), 'DAYOFMONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day),
        'WEEKDAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).weekday()), 'DAYOFWEEK':(1,lambda d:(parsed(d).weekday()+1)%7+1),
        'DATEDIFF':(2,lambda a,b:(parsed(a)-parsed(b)).days),
        'TIMESTAMPDIFF':(3,lambda unit,a,b:int((parsed(b)-parsed(a)).total_seconds()/{'SECOND':1,'MINUTE':60,'HOUR':3600,'DAY':86400}[unit])),
        'DATE_FORMAT':(2,lambda d,f:parsed(d).strftime(f.replace('%i','%M'))),
        'DATE_ADD':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)+datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'DATE_SUB':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)-datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'GREATEST':(-1,lambda *a:max(a)), 'LEAST':(-1,lambda *a:min(a)),
        'FLOOR':(1,math.floor),'CEIL':(1,math.ceil),'CEILING':(1,math.ceil),
        'LEFT':(2,lambda s,n:s[:n]),'RIGHT':(2,lambda s,n:s[-n:]),
        'REGEXP':(2,lambda pattern,value:bool(re.search(pattern,str(value))))
    }
    for name,(arity,function) in functions.items():
        connection.create_function(name,arity,function)
    return connection

class Solution:

    def spiralMatrix(self, m, n, head):
        DIRS = ((0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1), (-1, 0))
        ans = [[-1] * n for _ in range(m)]
        x = 0
        y = 0
        d = 0
        curr = head
        while curr:
            ans[x][y] = curr.val
            if x + DIRS[d][0] < 0 or x + DIRS[d][0] == m or y + DIRS[d][1] < 0 or (y + DIRS[d][1] == n) or (ans[x + DIRS[d][0]][y + DIRS[d][1]] != -1):
                d = (d + 1) % 4
            x += DIRS[d][0]
            y += DIRS[d][1]
            curr = curr.next
        return ans

code:
class Solution:

    def minimumCosts(self, regular, express, expressCost):
        n = len(regular)
        ans = [0] * n
        dpReg = 0
        dpExp = expressCost
        for i in range(n):
            prevReg = dpReg
            prevExp = dpExp
            dpReg = min(prevReg + regular[i], prevExp + 0 + regular[i])
            dpExp = min(prevReg + expressCost + express[i], prevExp + express[i])
            ans[i] = min(dpReg, dpExp)
        return ans

title: Merge Operations to Turn Array Into a Palindrome
code:
class Solution:

    def minimumOperations(self, nums):
        ans = 0
        l = 0
        r = len(nums) - 1
        leftSum = nums[0]
        rightSum = nums[-1]
        while l < r:
            if leftSum < rightSum:
                l += 1
                leftSum += nums[l]
                ans += 1
            elif leftSum > rightSum:
                r -= 1
                rightSum += nums[r]
                ans += 1
            else:
                l += 1
                r -= 1
                leftSum = nums[l]
                rightSum = nums[r]
        return ans

class Solution:
    def run(self, tables):
        connection = _sql_connection()
        for name, rows in tables.items():
            if not rows:
                continue
            columns = list(rows[0])
            definitions = []
            for column in columns:
                values = [row[column] for row in rows if row[column] is not None]
                kind = "NUMERIC" if values and all(isinstance(value,(int,float)) for value in values) else "TEXT"
                definitions.append(chr(34)+column+chr(34)+" "+kind)
            connection.execute("CREATE TABLE "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" ("+",".join(definitions)+")")
            placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in columns)
            connection.executemany("INSERT INTO "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" VALUES ("+placeholders+")",[[row[c] for c in columns] for row in rows])
        stages = []
        intermediate = []
        for stage, statement in stages:
            rows = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(statement)]
            intermediate.append({"stage":stage,"rows":rows})
        query = 'SELECT customer_id\nFROM (\n    SELECT\n        customer_id,\n        YEAR(order_date),\n        SUM(price) AS total,\n        YEAR(order_date) - RANK() OVER (\n            PARTITION BY customer_id\n            ORDER BY SUM(price)\n        ) AS rk\n    FROM Orders\n    GROUP BY customer_id, YEAR(order_date)\n) AS t\nGROUP BY customer_id\nHAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rk) = 1;'
        result = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(query)]
        result.sort(key=lambda row: json.dumps(row,sort_keys=True))
        connection.close()
        return result

import sqlite3,datetime,calendar
def _sql_connection():
    connection=sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
    connection.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    def parsed(value):
        return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(str(value))
    functions={
        'CONCAT':(-1,lambda *values: ''.join(str(v) for v in values)),
        'CONCAT_WS':(-1,lambda separator,*values: separator.join(str(v) for v in values if v is not None)),
        'IF':(3,lambda c,a,b:a if c else b),
        'YEAR':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).year), 'MONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).month),
        'DAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day), 'DAYOFMONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day),
        'WEEKDAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).weekday()), 'DAYOFWEEK':(1,lambda d:(parsed(d).weekday()+1)%7+1),
        'DATEDIFF':(2,lambda a,b:(parsed(a)-parsed(b)).days),
        'TIMESTAMPDIFF':(3,lambda unit,a,b:int((parsed(b)-parsed(a)).total_seconds()/{'SECOND':1,'MINUTE':60,'HOUR':3600,'DAY':86400}[unit])),
        'DATE_FORMAT':(2,lambda d,f:parsed(d).strftime(f.replace('%i','%M'))),
        'DATE_ADD':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)+datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'DATE_SUB':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)-datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'GREATEST':(-1,lambda *a:max(a)), 'LEAST':(-1,lambda *a:min(a)),
        'FLOOR':(1,math.floor),'CEIL':(1,math.ceil),'CEILING':(1,math.ceil),
        'LEFT':(2,lambda s,n:s[:n]),'RIGHT':(2,lambda s,n:s[-n:]),
        'REGEXP':(2,lambda pattern,value:bool(re.search(pattern,str(value))))
    }
    for name,(arity,function) in functions.items():
        connection.create_function(name,arity,function)
    return connection

import sqlite3,datetime,calendar
def _sql_connection():
    connection=sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
    connection.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    def parsed(value):
        return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(str(value))
    functions={
        'CONCAT':(-1,lambda *values: ''.join(str(v) for v in values)),
        'CONCAT_WS':(-1,lambda separator,*values: separator.join(str(v) for v in values if v is not None)),
        'IF':(3,lambda c,a,b:a if c else b),
        'YEAR':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).year), 'MONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).month),
        'DAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day), 'DAYOFMONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day),
        'WEEKDAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).weekday()), 'DAYOFWEEK':(1,lambda d:(parsed(d).weekday()+1)%7+1),
        'DATEDIFF':(2,lambda a,b:(parsed(a)-parsed(b)).days),
        'TIMESTAMPDIFF':(3,lambda unit,a,b:int((parsed(b)-parsed(a)).total_seconds()/{'SECOND':1,'MINUTE':60,'HOUR':3600,'DAY':86400}[unit])),
        'DATE_FORMAT':(2,lambda d,f:parsed(d).strftime(f.replace('%i','%M'))),
        'DATE_ADD':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)+datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'DATE_SUB':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)-datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'GREATEST':(-1,lambda *a:max(a)), 'LEAST':(-1,lambda *a:min(a)),
        'FLOOR':(1,math.floor),'CEIL':(1,math.ceil),'CEILING':(1,math.ceil),
        'LEFT':(2,lambda s,n:s[:n]),'RIGHT':(2,lambda s,n:s[-n:]),
        'REGEXP':(2,lambda pattern,value:bool(re.search(pattern,str(value))))
    }
    for name,(arity,function) in functions.items():
        connection.create_function(name,arity,function)
    return connection

title: Concatenate the Name and the Profession
code:
class Solution:
    def run(self, tables):
        connection = _sql_connection()
        for name, rows in tables.items():
            if not rows:
                continue
            columns = list(rows[0])
            definitions = []
            for column in columns:
                values = [row[column] for row in rows if row[column] is not None]
                kind = "NUMERIC" if values and all(isinstance(value,(int,float)) for value in values) else "TEXT"
                definitions.append(chr(34)+column+chr(34)+" "+kind)
            connection.execute("CREATE TABLE "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" ("+",".join(definitions)+")")
            placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in columns)
            connection.executemany("INSERT INTO "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" VALUES ("+placeholders+")",[[row[c] for c in columns] for row in rows])
        stages = []
        intermediate = []
        for stage, statement in stages:
            rows = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(statement)]
            intermediate.append({"stage":stage,"rows":rows})
        query = 'SELECT person_id, CONCAT(name, "(", SUBSTRING(profession, 1, 1), ")") AS name\nFROM Person\nORDER BY person_id DESC;'
        result = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(query)]
        connection.close()
        return result

import sqlite3,datetime,calendar
def _sql_connection():
    connection=sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
    connection.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    def parsed(value):
        return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(str(value))
    functions={
        'CONCAT':(-1,lambda *values: ''.join(str(v) for v in values)),
        'CONCAT_WS':(-1,lambda separator,*values: separator.join(str(v) for v in values if v is not None)),
        'IF':(3,lambda c,a,b:a if c else b),
        'YEAR':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).year), 'MONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).month),
        'DAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day), 'DAYOFMONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day),
        'WEEKDAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).weekday()), 'DAYOFWEEK':(1,lambda d:(parsed(d).weekday()+1)%7+1),
        'DATEDIFF':(2,lambda a,b:(parsed(a)-parsed(b)).days),
        'TIMESTAMPDIFF':(3,lambda unit,a,b:int((parsed(b)-parsed(a)).total_seconds()/{'SECOND':1,'MINUTE':60,'HOUR':3600,'DAY':86400}[unit])),
        'DATE_FORMAT':(2,lambda d,f:parsed(d).strftime(f.replace('%i','%M'))),
        'DATE_ADD':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)+datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'DATE_SUB':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)-datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'GREATEST':(-1,lambda *a:max(a)), 'LEAST':(-1,lambda *a:min(a)),
        'FLOOR':(1,math.floor),'CEIL':(1,math.ceil),'CEILING':(1,math.ceil),
        'LEFT':(2,lambda s,n:s[:n]),'RIGHT':(2,lambda s,n:s[-n:]),
        'REGEXP':(2,lambda pattern,value:bool(re.search(pattern,str(value))))
    }
    for name,(arity,function) in functions.items():
        connection.create_function(name,arity,function)
    return connection

title: Time to Cross a Bridge
code:
class Solution:

    def findCrossingTime(self, n, k, time):
        ans = 0
        leftBridgeQueue = [(-leftToRight - rightToLeft, -i) for i, (leftToRight, pickOld, rightToLeft, pickNew) in enumerate(time)]
        rightBridgeQueue = []
        leftWorkers = []
        rightWorkers = []
        heapq.heapify(leftBridgeQueue)
        while n > 0 or rightBridgeQueue or rightWorkers:
            while leftWorkers and leftWorkers[0][0] <= ans:
                i = heapq.heappop(leftWorkers)[1]
                leftWorkers.pop()
                heapq.heappush(leftBridgeQueue, (-time[i][0] - time[i][2], -i))
            while rightWorkers and rightWorkers[0][0] <= ans:
                i = heapq.heappop(rightWorkers)[1]
                heapq.heappush(rightBridgeQueue, (-time[i][0] - time[i][2], -i))
            if rightBridgeQueue:
                i = -heapq.heappop(rightBridgeQueue)[1]
                ans += time[i][2]
                heapq.heappush(leftWorkers, (ans + time[i][3], i))
            elif leftBridgeQueue and n > 0:
                i = -heapq.heappop(leftBridgeQueue)[1]
                ans += time[i][0]
                heapq.heappush(rightWorkers, (ans + time[i][1], i))
                n -= 1
            else:
                ans = min(leftWorkers[0][0] if leftWorkers and n > 0 else math.inf, rightWorkers[0][0] if rightWorkers else math.inf)
        return ans

title: Minimum Operations to Make All Array Elements Equal
code:
class Solution:

    def minOperations(self, nums, queries):
        n = len(nums)
        nums.sort()
        prefix = list(itertools.accumulate(nums, initial=0))
        splits = [(query, bisect_right(nums, query)) for query in queries]
        return [query * i - prefix[i] + (prefix[-1] - prefix[i] - query * (n - i)) for query, i in splits]

title: Minimum Reverse Operations
code:
class Solution:

    def minReverseOperations(self, n, p, banned, k):
        bannedSet = set(banned)
        ans = [-1] * n
        unseen = [SortedList(), SortedList()]
        for num in range(n):
            if num != p and num not in bannedSet:
                unseen[num % 2].add(num)
        q = collections.deque([p])
        ans[p] = 0
        while q:
            u = q.popleft()
            lo = max(u - k + 1, k - 1 - u)
            hi = min(u + k - 1, n - 1 - (u - (n - k)))
            nums = unseen[lo % 2]
            i = nums.bisect_left(lo)
            while i < len(nums) and nums[i] <= hi:
                num = nums[i]
                ans[num] = ans[u] + 1
                q.append(num)
                nums.pop(i)
        return ans

title: Find Latest Salaries
code:
class Solution:
    def run(self, tables):
        connection = _sql_connection()
        for name, rows in tables.items():
            if not rows:
                continue
            columns = list(rows[0])
            definitions = []
            for column in columns:
                values = [row[column] for row in rows if row[column] is not None]
                kind = "NUMERIC" if values and all(isinstance(value,(int,float)) for value in values) else "TEXT"
                definitions.append(chr(34)+column+chr(34)+" "+kind)
            connection.execute("CREATE TABLE "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" ("+",".join(definitions)+")")
            placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in columns)
            connection.executemany("INSERT INTO "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" VALUES ("+placeholders+")",[[row[c] for c in columns] for row in rows])
        stages = []
        intermediate = []
        for stage, statement in stages:
            rows = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(statement)]
            intermediate.append({"stage":stage,"rows":rows})
        query = 'SELECT\n    emp_id,\n    firstname,\n    lastname,\n    MAX(salary) AS salary,\n    department_id\nFROM Salary\nGROUP BY emp_id\nORDER BY emp_id;'
        result = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(query)]
        connection.close()
        return result

title: Find the Losers of the Circular Game
code:
class Solution:

    def circularGameLosers(self, n, k):
        seen = [False] * n
        friendIndex = 0
        turn = 1
        while not seen[friendIndex]:
            seen[friendIndex] = True
            friendIndex += turn * k
            friendIndex %= n
            turn += 1
        return [friendIndex + 1 for friendIndex in range(n) if not seen[friendIndex]]

title: Difference of Number of Distinct Values on Diagonals
code:
class Solution:

    def differenceOfDistinctValues(self, grid):
        m = len(grid)
        n = len(grid[0])
        ans = [[0] * n for _ in range(m)]

        def fillInDiagonal(i, j):
            topLeft = set()
            bottomRight = set()
            while i < len(grid) and j < len(grid[0]):
                ans[i][j] = len(topLeft)
                topLeft.add(grid[i][j])
                i += 1
                j += 1
            i -= 1
            j -= 1
            while i >= 0 and j >= 0:
                ans[i][j] = abs(ans[i][j] - len(bottomRight))
                bottomRight.add(grid[i][j])
                i -= 1
                j -= 1
        for i in range(m):
            fillInDiagonal(i, 0)
        for j in range(1, n):
            fillInDiagonal(0, j)
        return ans

title: Continuous Subarrays
code:
class Solution:

    def continuousSubarrays(self, nums):
        ans = 1
        left = nums[0] - 2
        right = nums[0] + 2
        l = 0
        for r in range(1, len(nums)):
            if left <= nums[r] <= right:
                left = max(left, nums[r] - 2)
                right = min(right, nums[r] + 2)
            else:
                left = nums[r] - 2
                right = nums[r] + 2
                l = r
                while nums[r] - 2 <= nums[l] <= nums[r] + 2:
                    left = max(left, nums[l] - 2)
                    right = min(right, nums[l] + 2)
                    l -= 1
                l += 1
            ans += r - l + 1
        return ans

title: Sum of Imbalance Numbers of All Subarrays
code:
class Solution:

    def sumImbalanceNumbers(self, nums):
        n = len(nums)
        left = [0] * n
        right = [0] * n
        numToIndex = [-1] * (n + 2)
        for i, num in enumerate(nums):
            left[i] = max(numToIndex[num], numToIndex[num + 1])
            numToIndex[num] = i
        numToIndex = [n] * (n + 2)
        for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
            right[i] = numToIndex[nums[i] + 1]
            numToIndex[nums[i]] = i
        return sum(((i - left[i]) * (right[i] - i) for i in range(n))) - n * (n + 1) // 2

code:
class Solution:
    def run(self, tables):
        connection = _sql_connection()
        for name, rows in tables.items():
            if not rows:
                continue
            columns = list(rows[0])
            definitions = []
            for column in columns:
                values = [row[column] for row in rows if row[column] is not None]
                kind = "NUMERIC" if values and all(isinstance(value,(int,float)) for value in values) else "TEXT"
                definitions.append(chr(34)+column+chr(34)+" "+kind)
            connection.execute("CREATE TABLE "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" ("+",".join(definitions)+")")
            placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in columns)
            connection.executemany("INSERT INTO "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" VALUES ("+placeholders+")",[[row[c] for c in columns] for row in rows])
        stages = []
        intermediate = []
        for stage, statement in stages:
            rows = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(statement)]
            intermediate.append({"stage":stage,"rows":rows})
        query = "SELECT\n    passenger_id,\n    IF(\n        (\n            RANK() OVER (\n                PARTITION BY flight_id\n                ORDER BY booking_time\n            )\n        ) <= capacity,\n        'Confirmed',\n        'Waitlist'\n    ) AS Status\nFROM Passengers\nJOIN Flights USING (flight_id)\nORDER BY passenger_id;"
        result = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(query)]
        connection.close()
        return result

import sqlite3,datetime,calendar
def _sql_connection():
    connection=sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
    connection.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    def parsed(value):
        return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(str(value))
    functions={
        'CONCAT':(-1,lambda *values: ''.join(str(v) for v in values)),
        'CONCAT_WS':(-1,lambda separator,*values: separator.join(str(v) for v in values if v is not None)),
        'IF':(3,lambda c,a,b:a if c else b),
        'YEAR':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).year), 'MONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).month),
        'DAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day), 'DAYOFMONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day),
        'WEEKDAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).weekday()), 'DAYOFWEEK':(1,lambda d:(parsed(d).weekday()+1)%7+1),
        'DATEDIFF':(2,lambda a,b:(parsed(a)-parsed(b)).days),
        'TIMESTAMPDIFF':(3,lambda unit,a,b:int((parsed(b)-parsed(a)).total_seconds()/{'SECOND':1,'MINUTE':60,'HOUR':3600,'DAY':86400}[unit])),
        'DATE_FORMAT':(2,lambda d,f:parsed(d).strftime(f.replace('%i','%M'))),
        'DATE_ADD':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)+datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'DATE_SUB':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)-datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'GREATEST':(-1,lambda *a:max(a)), 'LEAST':(-1,lambda *a:min(a)),
        'FLOOR':(1,math.floor),'CEIL':(1,math.ceil),'CEILING':(1,math.ceil),
        'LEFT':(2,lambda s,n:s[:n]),'RIGHT':(2,lambda s,n:s[-n:]),
        'REGEXP':(2,lambda pattern,value:bool(re.search(pattern,str(value))))
    }
    for name,(arity,function) in functions.items():
        connection.create_function(name,arity,function)
    return connection

title: Minimum Relative Loss After Buying Chocolates
code:
class Solution:

    def minimumRelativeLosses(self, prices, queries):
        ans = []
        prices.sort()
        prefix = list(itertools.accumulate(prices, initial=0))
        for k, m in queries:
            countFront = self._getCountFront(k, m, prices)
            countBack = m - countFront
            ans.append(self._getRelativeLoss(countFront, countBack, k, prefix))
        return ans

    def _getCountFront(self, k, m, prices):
        """Returns `countFront` for query (k, m).

    Returns `countFront` for query (k, m) s.t. picking the first `countFront`
    and the last `m - countFront` chocolates is optimal.

    Define loss[i] := the relative loss of picking `prices[i]`.
    1. For prices[i] <= k, Bob pays prices[i] while Alice pays 0.
       Thus, loss[i] = prices[i] - 0 = prices[i].
    2. For prices[i] > k, Bob pays k while Alice pays prices[i] - k.
       Thus, loss[i] = k - (prices[i] - k) = 2 * k - prices[i].
    By observation, we deduce that it is always better to pick from the front
    or the back since loss[i] is increasing for 1. and is decreasing for 2.

    Assume that picking `left` chocolates from the left and `right = m - left`
    chocolates from the right is optimal. Therefore, we are selecting
    chocolates from `prices[0..left - 1]` and `prices[n - right..n - 1]`.

    To determine the optimal `left` in each iteration, we simply compare
    `loss[left]` with `loss[n - right]` if `loss[left] < loss[n - right]`,
    it's worth increasing `left`.
    """
        n = len(prices)
        countNoGreaterThanK = bisect_right(prices, k)
        l = 0
        r = min(countNoGreaterThanK, m)
        while l < r:
            mid = (l + r) // 2
            right = m - mid
            if prices[mid] < 2 * k - prices[n - right]:
                l = mid + 1
            else:
                r = mid
        return l

    def _getRelativeLoss(self, countFront, countBack, k, prefix):
        """
    Returns the relative loss of picking `countFront` and `countBack` 
    chocolates.
    """
        lossFront = prefix[countFront]
        lossBack = 2 * k * countBack - (prefix[-1] - prefix[-countBack - 1])
        return lossFront + lossBack

class Solution:
    def run(self, tables):
        connection = _sql_connection()
        for name, rows in tables.items():
            if not rows:
                continue
            columns = list(rows[0])
            definitions = []
            for column in columns:
                values = [row[column] for row in rows if row[column] is not None]
                kind = "NUMERIC" if values and all(isinstance(value,(int,float)) for value in values) else "TEXT"
                definitions.append(chr(34)+column+chr(34)+" "+kind)
            connection.execute("CREATE TABLE "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" ("+",".join(definitions)+")")
            placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in columns)
            connection.executemany("INSERT INTO "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" VALUES ("+placeholders+")",[[row[c] for c in columns] for row in rows])
        stages = []
        intermediate = []
        for stage, statement in stages:
            rows = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(statement)]
            intermediate.append({"stage":stage,"rows":rows})
        query = "SELECT user_id, name, IFNULL(SUM(distance), 0) AS 'traveled distance'\nFROM Users\nLEFT JOIN Rides USING (user_id)\nGROUP BY 1\nORDER BY 1;"
        result = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(query)]
        connection.close()
        return result

title: String Transformation
code:
class Solution:

    def numberOfWays(self, s, t, k):
        MOD = 1000000007
        n = len(s)
        negOnePowK = 1 if k % 2 == 0 else -1
        z = self._zFunction(s + t + t)
        indices = [i - n for i in range(n, n + n) if z[i] >= n]
        dp = [0] * 2
        dp[1] = (pow(n - 1, k, MOD) - negOnePowK) * pow(n, MOD - 2, MOD)
        dp[0] = dp[1] + negOnePowK
        return sum((dp[0] if index == 0 else dp[1] for index in indices)) % MOD

    def _zFunction(self, s):
        """
    Returns the z array, where z[i] is the length of the longest prefix of
    s[i..n) which is also a prefix of s.

    https://cp-algorithms.com/string/z-function.html#implementation
    """
        n = len(s)
        z = [0] * n
        l = 0
        r = 0
        for i in range(1, n):
            if i < r:
                z[i] = min(r - i, z[i - l])
            while i + z[i] < n and s[z[i]] == s[i + z[i]]:
                z[i] += 1
            if i + z[i] > r:
                l = i
                r = i + z[i]
        return z

class Solution:
    def run(self, tables):
        connection = _sql_connection()
        for name, rows in tables.items():
            if not rows:
                continue
            columns = list(rows[0])
            definitions = []
            for column in columns:
                values = [row[column] for row in rows if row[column] is not None]
                kind = "NUMERIC" if values and all(isinstance(value,(int,float)) for value in values) else "TEXT"
                definitions.append(chr(34)+column+chr(34)+" "+kind)
            connection.execute("CREATE TABLE "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" ("+",".join(definitions)+")")
            placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in columns)
            connection.executemany("INSERT INTO "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" VALUES ("+placeholders+")",[[row[c] for c in columns] for row in rows])
        stages = []
        intermediate = []
        for stage, statement in stages:
            rows = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(statement)]
            intermediate.append({"stage":stage,"rows":rows})
        query = 'SELECT MAX(s) - MIN(s) AS salary_difference\nFROM (\n    SELECT MAX(salary) AS s\n    FROM Salaries\n    GROUP BY department\n) AS t;'
        result = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(query)]
        connection.close()
        return result

def _sql_connection():
    connection=sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
    connection.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    def parsed(value):
        return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(str(value))
    functions={
        'CONCAT':(-1,lambda *values: ''.join(str(v) for v in values)),
        'CONCAT_WS':(-1,lambda separator,*values: separator.join(str(v) for v in values if v is not None)),
        'IF':(3,lambda c,a,b:a if c else b),
        'YEAR':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).year), 'MONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).month),
        'DAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day), 'DAYOFMONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day),
        'WEEKDAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).weekday()), 'DAYOFWEEK':(1,lambda d:(parsed(d).weekday()+1)%7+1),
        'DATEDIFF':(2,lambda a,b:(parsed(a)-parsed(b)).days),
        'TIMESTAMPDIFF':(3,lambda unit,a,b:int((parsed(b)-parsed(a)).total_seconds()/{'SECOND':1,'MINUTE':60,'HOUR':3600,'DAY':86400}[unit])),
        'DATE_FORMAT':(2,lambda d,f:parsed(d).strftime(f.replace('%i','%M'))),
        'DATE_ADD':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)+datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'DATE_SUB':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)-datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'GREATEST':(-1,lambda *a:max(a)), 'LEAST':(-1,lambda *a:min(a)),
        'FLOOR':(1,math.floor),'CEIL':(1,math.ceil),'CEILING':(1,math.ceil),
        'LEFT':(2,lambda s,n:s[:n]),'RIGHT':(2,lambda s,n:s[-n:]),
        'REGEXP':(2,lambda pattern,value:bool(re.search(pattern,str(value))))
    }
    for name,(arity,function) in functions.items():
        connection.create_function(name,arity,function)
    return connection

title: Calculate Orders Within Each Interval
code:
class Solution:
    def run(self, tables):
        connection = _sql_connection()
        for name, rows in tables.items():
            if not rows:
                continue
            columns = list(rows[0])
            definitions = []
            for column in columns:
                values = [row[column] for row in rows if row[column] is not None]
                kind = "NUMERIC" if values and all(isinstance(value,(int,float)) for value in values) else "TEXT"
                definitions.append(chr(34)+column+chr(34)+" "+kind)
            connection.execute("CREATE TABLE "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" ("+",".join(definitions)+")")
            placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in columns)
            connection.executemany("INSERT INTO "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" VALUES ("+placeholders+")",[[row[c] for c in columns] for row in rows])
        stages = []
        intermediate = []
        for stage, statement in stages:
            rows = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(statement)]
            intermediate.append({"stage":stage,"rows":rows})
        query = 'SELECT\n    (minute + 5) DIV 6 AS interval_no,\n    SUM(order_count) AS total_orders\nFROM Orders\nGROUP BY 1\nORDER BY 1;'
        result = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(query)]
        connection.close()
        return result

import sqlite3,datetime,calendar
def _sql_connection():
    connection=sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
    connection.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    def parsed(value):
        return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(str(value))
    functions={
        'CONCAT':(-1,lambda *values: ''.join(str(v) for v in values)),
        'CONCAT_WS':(-1,lambda separator,*values: separator.join(str(v) for v in values if v is not None)),
        'IF':(3,lambda c,a,b:a if c else b),
        'YEAR':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).year), 'MONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).month),
        'DAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day), 'DAYOFMONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day),
        'WEEKDAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).weekday()), 'DAYOFWEEK':(1,lambda d:(parsed(d).weekday()+1)%7+1),
        'DATEDIFF':(2,lambda a,b:(parsed(a)-parsed(b)).days),
        'TIMESTAMPDIFF':(3,lambda unit,a,b:int((parsed(b)-parsed(a)).total_seconds()/{'SECOND':1,'MINUTE':60,'HOUR':3600,'DAY':86400}[unit])),
        'DATE_FORMAT':(2,lambda d,f:parsed(d).strftime(f.replace('%i','%M'))),
        'DATE_ADD':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)+datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'DATE_SUB':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)-datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'GREATEST':(-1,lambda *a:max(a)), 'LEAST':(-1,lambda *a:min(a)),
        'FLOOR':(1,math.floor),'CEIL':(1,math.ceil),'CEILING':(1,math.ceil),
        'LEFT':(2,lambda s,n:s[:n]),'RIGHT':(2,lambda s,n:s[-n:]),
        'REGEXP':(2,lambda pattern,value:bool(re.search(pattern,str(value))))
    }
    for name,(arity,function) in functions.items():
        connection.create_function(name,arity,function)
    return connection

title: Divisible and Non-divisible Sums Difference
code:
class Solution:

    def differenceOfSums(self, n, m):
        summ = (1 + n) * n // 2
        num2 = self._getDivisibleSum(n, m)
        num1 = summ - num2
        return num1 - num2

    def _getDivisibleSum(self, n, m):
        """Returns the sum of all the integers in [1, n] that are divisible by m."""
        last = n // m * m
        if last == 0:
            return 0
        first = m
        count = (last - first) // m + 1
        return (first + last) * count // 2

class Solution:
    def run(self, tables):
        connection = _sql_connection()
        for name, rows in tables.items():
            if not rows:
                continue
            columns = list(rows[0])
            definitions = []
            for column in columns:
                values = [row[column] for row in rows if row[column] is not None]
                kind = "NUMERIC" if values and all(isinstance(value,(int,float)) for value in values) else "TEXT"
                definitions.append(chr(34)+column+chr(34)+" "+kind)
            connection.execute("CREATE TABLE "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" ("+",".join(definitions)+")")
            placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in columns)
            connection.executemany("INSERT INTO "+chr(34)+name+chr(34)+" VALUES ("+placeholders+")",[[row[c] for c in columns] for row in rows])
        stages = [['T', 'WITH\n    T AS (\n        SELECT seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT item_id) AS num_items\n        FROM Orders\n        JOIN Users USING (seller_id)\n        JOIN Items USING (item_id)\n        WHERE item_brand != favorite_brand\n        GROUP BY 1\n    ) SELECT * FROM T']]
        intermediate = []
        for stage, statement in stages:
            rows = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(statement)]
            intermediate.append({"stage":stage,"rows":rows})
        query = 'WITH\n    T AS (\n        SELECT seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT item_id) AS num_items\n        FROM Orders\n        JOIN Users USING (seller_id)\n        JOIN Items USING (item_id)\n        WHERE item_brand != favorite_brand\n        GROUP BY 1\n    )\nSELECT seller_id, num_items\nFROM T\nWHERE num_items = (SELECT MAX(num_items) FROM T)\nORDER BY 1;'
        result = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(query)]
        connection.close()
        return result

import sqlite3,datetime,calendar
def _sql_connection():
    connection=sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
    connection.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    def parsed(value):
        return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(str(value))
    functions={
        'CONCAT':(-1,lambda *values: ''.join(str(v) for v in values)),
        'CONCAT_WS':(-1,lambda separator,*values: separator.join(str(v) for v in values if v is not None)),
        'IF':(3,lambda c,a,b:a if c else b),
        'YEAR':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).year), 'MONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).month),
        'DAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day), 'DAYOFMONTH':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).day),
        'WEEKDAY':(1,lambda d:parsed(d).weekday()), 'DAYOFWEEK':(1,lambda d:(parsed(d).weekday()+1)%7+1),
        'DATEDIFF':(2,lambda a,b:(parsed(a)-parsed(b)).days),
        'TIMESTAMPDIFF':(3,lambda unit,a,b:int((parsed(b)-parsed(a)).total_seconds()/{'SECOND':1,'MINUTE':60,'HOUR':3600,'DAY':86400}[unit])),
        'DATE_FORMAT':(2,lambda d,f:parsed(d).strftime(f.replace('%i','%M'))),
        'DATE_ADD':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)+datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'DATE_SUB':(3,lambda d,n,unit:(parsed(d)-datetime.timedelta(**{unit.lower()+'s':n})).isoformat(sep=' ')),
        'GREATEST':(-1,lambda *a:max(a)), 'LEAST':(-1,lambda *a:min(a)),
        'FLOOR':(1,math.floor),'CEIL':(1,math.ceil),'CEILING':(1,math.ceil),
        'LEFT':(2,lambda s,n:s[:n]),'RIGHT':(2,lambda s,n:s[-n:]),
        'REGEXP':(2,lambda pattern,value:bool(re.search(pattern,str(value))))
    }
    for name,(arity,function) in functions.items():
        connection.create_function(name,arity,function)
    return connection

title: Number of Strings Which Can Be Rearranged to Contain Substring
code:
class Solution:

    def stringCount(self, n):
        MOD = 1000000007
        allCount = pow(26, n, MOD)
        a = pow(25, n, MOD)
        b = pow(25, n, MOD)
        c = pow(25, n, MOD) + n * pow(25, n - 1, MOD)
        ab = pow(24, n, MOD) + n * pow(24, n - 1, MOD)
        ac = pow(24, n, MOD)
        bc = pow(24, n, MOD) + n * pow(24, n - 1, MOD)
        abc = pow(23, n, MOD) + n * pow(23, n - 1, MOD)
        return (allCount - a - b - c + ab + ac + bc - abc) % MOD
